flags: The cache does not establish the byway’s construction history, designation year or full route to US 191/Knox Ridge Road. Intro ends at the last supported route anchor rather than inventing an end-to-end description.

Visit Montana gives about 80 miles; material maps 60.2 miles. Mileage omitted. Material strip miles are not a coherent end-to-end order; retained Winifred–Deweese Ridge–bridge sequence, but cache does not independently locate the bridge on the byway.
Winifred, bridge and Deweese Ridge moments are short because the selected place stories are simple and landmark-specific evidence is thin. No reason for the bridge controversy is supplied.

Dropped current claims that the whole road traverses the monument and ends at US 191 near the bridge: the cached byway list has no route entries. Wet-road advice is checked against saved evidence only, not live conditions.
